instruction: Extract the project context, objective, actors, scope, constraints, assumptions, and missing information from the stakeholder input.
input: CabinFern Cleaning Clearance brief: The objective is to coordinate vehicle-cleaning tasks and return vehicles to the assignment pool only after hygiene clearance. Drivers report cleanliness issues and identify the vehicle and affected area. Fleet Service Coordinators create cleaning tasks and assign priorities. Cleaning Technicians record cleaning actions and task completion. Hygiene Inspectors record vehicles as cleared or requiring repeat cleaning. Fleet Schedulers return vehicles to the assignment pool only after clearance. Cleaning-supplier payment and mechanical repair are outside the project. The priority rule and clearance criteria are not finalized.

output.business_objective: Coordinate vehicle-cleaning tasks and return vehicles to the assignment pool only after hygiene clearance.

instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: CabinFern Cleaning Clearance coordinates vehicle-cleanliness reporting, cleaning-task creation, cleaning work, hygiene inspection, and return to the assignment pool. Drivers identify the vehicle and affected area, Fleet Service Coordinators create and prioritize tasks, Cleaning Technicians record actions and completion, and Hygiene Inspectors record clearance or repeat-cleaning outcomes. Fleet Schedulers return vehicles to the assignment pool only when cleared. Supplier payment and mechanical repair are excluded, while the priority rule and clearance criteria remain unresolved.

output.summary: CabinFern Cleaning Clearance coordinates vehicle-cleanliness issues from driver reporting through cleaning and hygiene inspection. Fleet Service Coordinators create and prioritize tasks, Cleaning Technicians record work and completion, and Hygiene Inspectors determine whether repeat cleaning is required. Fleet Schedulers return vehicles to the assignment pool only after clearance; supplier payment and mechanical repair are excluded.
output.primary_goal: Coordinate vehicle-cleaning tasks and return vehicles to the assignment pool only after hygiene clearance.
key_capabilities: Report cleanliness issues with vehicle and affected-area information.
Record cleaning actions and task completion.
Return cleared vehicles to the assignment pool.
unresolved_points: The cleaning-task priority rule remains unresolved.
